events.title: Lua 1.1 first public release
events.summary: Luiz Henrique de Figueiredo announced the first public Lua release on Usenet on July 8, 1994 — an embeddable extension language from PUC-Rio.
events.about: Lua is a tiny embeddable scripting language — game engines (World of Warcraft, Roblox, Love2D), Redis scripting, nginx/OpenResty, and hardware firmware use it for configuration and logic without restarting the host app. Lightweight tables replace arrays and objects; one Lua state fits in kilobytes of RAM.

narrative.whyChosen: Lua became the default embeddable language when apps needed scripting without shipping Python or JavaScript.
narrative.whyImportant: Its minimal design and C API influenced how game engines and infrastructure tools expose scriptable behavior.
narrative.problemSolved: Brazilian Petrobras projects needed a common configuration language smaller and simpler than Tcl or Perl.
